h: 2Baba celebrates estranged wife Annie Idibia on her birthday
p: 2Baba has publicly celebrated his estranged wife Annie Idibia on her birthday, sharing her photo on his Instagram story with his song 'Celebrate', sparking reactions from fans.
body: Music star 2Baba has drawn attention online after publicly celebrating his estranged wife, Annie Idibia, on her birthday.

On Friday, 13 November 2026, the singer, whose real name is Innocent Idibia, shared a photo of Annie on his Instagram story, set to his 2025 track 'Celebrate'. His brother and daughter Isabella also celebrated the actress. Fans quickly reacted, with responses ranging from warm to teasing as people debated what the gesture meant.

2Baba and Annie Idibia, an actress, were one of Nigeria's most talked-about celebrity couples for years and have children together. Their separation was announced in early 2025 amid very public tensions, and 2Baba has since been linked with Edo lawmaker Natasha Osawaru. Despite the split, the birthday post suggests goodwill remains between them.
more: 2Baba shared Annie's photo with his song 'Celebrate'.
The two are separated but share children.
